result:
Looking at these tasks, I need to master qlang's pipeline syntax, filtering, grouping, and data transformation patterns. Let me work through each task carefully.

Key observations:
- `|` chains operations
- `*` maps over elements
- `filter ~(...)` filters with predicates
- `groupBy ~(...)` groups by an expression
- Literals `{:key value}` reshape data
- `at :field` safely reads fields (null if missing)

H1: filter-chain.json
```
filter ~(and (/active | eq true) (and (/country | lower | eq "de") (at :age | if (type | eq ::number) (gte 30) false))) | * /name | sort
```

H2: orders.json
```
filter ~(/status | lower | eq "paid") | * /items | flat | * (mul /qty /price) | sum
```

H3: orders.json
```
groupBy ~(/customer | lower) | * count
```

H4: package.json
```
{:name /name :depCount (/dependencies | keys | count) :devDepCount (/devDependencies | keys | count) :scripts (/scripts | keys | sort)}
```

H5: issues.json
```
filter ~(/state | lower | eq "open") | sort ~([(999 | sub /comments) /id]) | take 3 | * /id
```

H6: issues.json
```
* (at :labels | if (type | eq ::vec) . []) | flat | * (lower) | distinct | sort
```

H7: issues.json
```
filter ~(/state | lower | eq "open") | groupBy ~(at :assignee | if (type | eq ::null) "unassigned" /login) | * count
```

H8: access.log
```
split "\n" | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~((split " " | /1 | lower | eq "error" | if . true (split " " | /1 | lower | eq "warn"))) | * (split " " | /2) | groupBy ~(/) | * count
```

H9: access.log
```
split "\n" | filter ~(count | gt 0) | filter ~((split " " | /1 | lower | eq "error" | if . true (split " " | /1 | lower | eq "warn"))) | * (split " " | drop 3 | filter ~(startsWith "user=") | * (split "=" | /1)) | flat | distinct | sort
```

H10: servers.csv
```
split "\n" | drop 1 | filter ~(count | gt 0) | * (split ",") | filter ~(and (/4 | lower | eq "up") (/2 | ne "")) | groupBy ~/1 | * (~({:sum (. * /2 | parseJson | sum) :count (. | count)} | /sum | div /count))
```

H11: settings.env
```
split "\n" | filter ~(and (count | gt 0) (not (startsWith "#"))) | * (split "=") | filter ~(/0 | lower | startsWith "db_") | reduce {} ~(combine {(/0 | lower | drop 3 | keyword): /1})
```

H12: config.json
```
:config / | /services | filter ~(/enabled | eq true) | * {:name /name :timeout ((/timeout | if (type | eq ::null) (config | /defaults | /timeout) .) ) :team (at :owner | if (type | eq ::null) "none" (at :team | if (type | eq ::null) "none" .))} | sort ~/name
```

H13: api_response.json
```
/results | filter ~(and (at :score | type | eq ::number) (at :score | gte 50)) | sort ~/score | reverse | * ([/profile/first, " ", /profile/last, ": ", (at :tags | if (type | eq ::null) [] . | join "|")] | join "")
```

Bird, dog!" | split " " | * (split "" | filter ~("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ" | contains .) | join "" | lower) | filter ~(count | gt 0) | groupBy ~/ | :counts / | keys | * ({:word . :count (/counts | at .)}) | sort ~([(999 | sub /count) /word]) | take 3
